# Team Zissou

> Websites, Google profiles and online bookings for independent businesses in the Netherlands and UK, built and looked after every month by Will Morley in Den Haag.

Team Zissou is a one-person studio run by Will Morley. It builds websites (mostly on Webflow, also Shopify and WordPress/WooCommerce) and then looks after them on a monthly plan: uptime, speed, Google search and Maps visibility, and visibility in AI answers. The site is in English.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://teamzissou.io/): what Team Zissou does, a client case study, prices, who it is for, FAQ and the contact form
- [Pricing](https://teamzissou.io/#pricing): a new website is €1,495 one-off; monthly care plans start at €95; the Launch plan is a €500 add-on; prices exclude VAT and Webflow hosting is billed at cost
- [FAQ](https://teamzissou.io/#faq): cost, time needed, webshops, taking over an existing site, AI search, ownership and stopping the plan
- [Contact](https://teamzissou.io/#contact): enquiry form
- [Terms and conditions](https://teamzissou.io/terms): standard terms for every proposal, governed by Dutch law
- [Privacy policy](https://teamzissou.io/privacy): what the form and cookieless analytics collect

## Services

- New website, €1,495 one-off: designed, built and launched
- Monthly care plan, from €95 a month: updates, monitoring, Google profile and search visibility
- Launch plan, €500 add-on: launch planning for a new business
- Taking over an existing website on a monthly plan
